explanation: Gibson launched the Les Paul solid-body guitar in 1952. Paul also layered many recordings of his own guitar on top of one another, a technique called overdubbing.

claims.text: Gibson introduced the Les Paul solid-body electric guitar in 1952.
The Les Paul name is not famous as a model of microphone, synthesizer or piano.
Les Paul pioneered overdubbing, recording several of his own guitar parts on top of one another.
Les Paul was a pioneer of multitrack recording.
